CW=footprint ('statewide_overlap_layer'=mass smeared over the whole state; 'state_nonmunicipal_remainder'=the unincorporated remainder; 'municipal:place:XXXXXXX'=one Census place). KNOWN INGESTION ARTIFACTS, stated explicitly so you do not have to infer them:
